procedure.md:
# Merge-and-deploy procedure

1. Confirm all required checks have passed.
2. Merge the PR to `main`.
3. Trigger deployment to staging.
4. Update the PR status to `deployed`.

Readiness is conditional: green CI is necessary but not sufficient. A blocking tag
or an unresolved linked ticket withholds merge until it is cleared.
